Interface HudCycleStrip.Source

Enclosing class:
HudCycleStrip
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface HudCycleStrip.Source
What a mod registers: the ring it would draw for a hotbar slot, if any.

The one method is also the source's on/off switch. Return null unless the feature is enabled, its HUD option is on, and the slot really has a ring; the strip draws nothing for a slot no source claims. A ring of fewer than two stacks draws nothing either.
